C5b_planted_foreign_residual.note: recovered_fraction is the share of a signal defined outside this pipeline's own residual that the frozen linear specification detects -- algebraically the regression slope of the tree residual on the linear residual, so it is the attenuation of a signal OF THAT SHAPE and of nothing else
